_doc: PRE-DEFINED MATERIALS (doc/OpenWork.md row MD; doc/TestSuitePlan.md 6b).  One entry = a Bravais lattice
type + its parameters (a.u., degrees), an optional integer superlattice re-basing T (columns), the atom
basis in FRACTIONAL coordinates of that (primitive, re-based) cell with an optional per-site spin (+1/-1,
the collinear magnetic decoration), and the pseudopotential vocabulary: species -> valence electrons.
Nelec is DERIVED (sum of valence over atoms), never stored.  NOTHING about a run lives here -- k-mesh, XC
grid, kT, basis set are the calculation's axes.  Boxes (an atom or molecule in a periodic cell whose
oracle is the molecular facade) are materials too: their 'box' size and 'd' bond length are geometry.
Lattice constants are the ones the anchored tests were banked at; changing one moves anchors.

Si_diamond.comment: Si conventional cubic a = 5.43 A; FCC primitive cell, two-atom diamond basis

Al_fcc.comment: Al FCC a = 4.05 A; one atom, 3s2 3p1 -- the degenerate-shell metal

Na_fcc.comment: FCC Na at Na's atomic density (density-matched to real BCC Na); 3s1 -> half-filled band

NaF_rocksalt.comment: rocksalt = FCC + two-atom basis; the sharpest multi-species ionic cell the suite runs

CsI_cscl.comment: CsCl structure = simple cubic + two-atom basis, a = 4.567 A; the d-projector test (Cs q1, I q7)

MnO_AFM2.comment: rocksalt MnO a = 4.445 A with the type-II AFM order: the FCC cell doubled along [111] (T re-basing), Mn sublattices +m at 0 and -m at 1/2, O at 1/4 and 3/4

Si_box16.comment: one Si pseudo-atom at the centre of a 16-bohr cubic box; oracle = the molecular facade (SIPP)

Na_box16.comment: one Na pseudo-atom (3s1 doublet) at the centre of a 16-bohr box

Mn_box16.comment: one Mn q7 pseudo-atom (4s2 3d5 sextet) at the centre of a 16-bohr box; the d-channel gate

O2_box16.comment: O2 at the experimental bond length 1.208 A = 2.282 bohr along x, centred in a 16-bohr box; the triplet gate

Mn2_box7.comment: two neutral Mn in a 7-bohr cubic box, CsCl/B2 arrangement, AFM flip on the second: the cheapest genuinely staggered crystal

Na2_box16.comment: Na2 at d = 5.8 bohr along x, centred in a 16-bohr box, AFM-seeded (+m/-m): the order-lost postcondition gate
